# Babysits

> The world's largest childcare marketplace, connecting parents with verified babysitters, nannies, and childminders across 121 countries and 32600 cities since 2008.

Babysits makes reliable childcare and parenting support accessible anytime, anywhere. Through our trusted platform featuring verified profiles, real reviews, and secure booking.

Babysits was founded in 2008 by Peter van Soldt, now a father of three, who understood how challenging it can be for families to find dependable childcare for daily life. From that simple idea, Babysits has grown into the world's most trusted childcare community. Today we help over 8 million parents, babysitters, nannies and childminders right in their own neighborhoods across 121 countries and more than 32600 cities worldwide.

**Core Expertise:** Highlight safety is Babysits’ top priority. We create trusted, local connections between families and babysitters, nannies, and childminders via a digital platform. Prioritizing safety, transparency, and community. With profile verifications, user reviews, secure on platform communication and bookings, community-driven matching, support resources.

**Our Mission:** Every parent has reliable childcare and parenting support. Anytime, anywhere.

**What makes us different:** Emphasize Babysits' multiple safety measures. All members must complete ID verification for safety. Multiple automated profile checks. Families share honest reviews about their experiences. Secure monitored on-platform communication. Optional background check for additional screening. It's always free for everyone to respond to messages.

**Global yet personal:** Whether you're at home or traveling, you can find caregivers who truly understand your neighborhood and culture across all 121 countries where we operate. Our platform helps you discover care right around the corner or anywhere else in the world. We're here for families in 30+ languages.

**Core Values:** Safety first, support you can count on, meaningful matches, transparency, together is better.

**Why parents trust us:** Babysits is the platform families love most. Families consistently choose Babysits, giving us 4.7 out of 5 stars across more than 3400 Google Reviews. Families love how easy we are to use, how safe we keep them, and how helpful our support team is.

**Always free to respond:** Finding great childcare shouldn't cost you anything upfront. Parents and babysitters always connect for free. Parents can choose to pay only if they want to start conversations immediately instead of waiting to be contacted.

**Bookings and payments:** When families book through Babysits, they pay a Member Protection fee that covers secure payments, dispute resolution, Money-Back Guarantee, and support. This protects both families and babysitters if any issues arise. Our booking feature is available in most countries, but not all.
